products.title: Vital Oud, Unisex, 100 ml
products.body_html:
Otoori Vital Oud Perfume: A unique olfactory experience, shrouded in the mystery of the East

A unisex fragrance that celebrates reinterpreted luxury

Are you looking for a perfume that will take you out of anonymity and reveal your enigmatic side? Then Otoori Vital Oud Perfume is the perfect choice for you! This unisex elixir envelops you in a unique olfactory experience, reinterpreting the classicism of oud wood with modern and captivating notes.

A sensory journey to the heart of the East

The first notes take you on a mysterious journey to the heart of the East. Delicate rose offers an unexpected floral sweetness, perfectly balanced by the spicy aroma of saffron. This unique combination awakens curiosity and prepares you for the heart of the perfume, shrouded in mystery.

The Vital Oud Secret: Oud wood reinterpreted

The heart of the perfume is dominated by the precious aroma of oud wood. Otoori Vital Oud Perfume is not satisfied with classicism, but offers a modern interpretation of this legendary note. Oud reveals its warm, slightly smoky side, enveloping you in a sensual and magnetic aura.

An opulent and captivating ending

As the perfume settles on the skin, the base notes reveal true opulence. Ciste labdanum, a precious aromatic resin, adds a slightly vanilla balsamic note, creating a feeling of understated luxury. The fine leather completes the olfactory experience with an elegant and slightly rebellious note, perfectly balancing the floral sweetness in the top notes and the intensity of the oud wood in the heart.

More than a perfume, a statement

Otoori Vital Oud Perfume is not just a perfume, it is a statement. It is a unique combination of delicate rose, spicy saffron, precious oud wood and opulent woody notes. It’s a perfect unisex fragrance for those who want to feel unique, mysterious and full of confidence. Wear it with confidence on special occasions, a romantic evening or whenever you want to highlight your enigmatic personality.

products.title: Santal Noir, Unisex, 100 ml
products.body_html:
Otoori Santal Noir perfume: The mystery of the Orient revealed in a bottle

A captivating unisex fragrance that takes you on a sensory journey

Are you looking for a perfume that will envelop you in mystery and sensuality? Then Otoori Santal Noir Perfume is the perfect choice for you! This unisex fragrance from Myperfumestakes you on an exciting olfactory journey through the Far East, revealing aromatic secrets hidden for centuries.

The first notes: a spicy and exotic invitation

The first notes of the perfume Otoori Santal Noirwake you up to reality with an explosion of warm spices. Aromatic cinnamon and woody bark provide a vibrant introduction that prepares you for the complex olfactory experience that follows. Ylang-ylang, an exotic flower from Southeast Asia, adds its delicate floral and slightly fruity aroma, perfectly balancing the spicy strength of cinnamon.

Floral heart with a sensual twist

As the fragrance settles on the skin, the opulent floral heart reveals its secrets. The rose, the king of flowers, offers its timeless elegance, creating a romantic feel. But Otoori Santal Noir is not a typical floral fragrance. The introduction of a leather note adds a sensual and mysterious dimension to this phase of the fragrance. The fine leather balances the sweetness of the rose, creating a perfect olfactory harmony.

Wooden base shrouded in mystery

The mystery continues with the reveal of the base notes. Ciste labdanum, a precious resin harvested from bushes in the Mediterranean region, provides a warm, slightly animalic balsamic note. This note blends perfectly with labdanum, another aromatic resin, which adds a balsamic and slightly vanilla sweetness. The leather also returns in the base notes, giving a sensual woody persistence to the Otoori Santal Noir fragrance.

Otoori Santal Noir perfume is not just a perfume, it is a story. It is a unique combination of warm spices, delicate floral notes with sensual accents and a woody base shrouded in mystery. It’s a perfect unisex fragrance for those who want to explore the Orient and reveal their enigmatic side.

products.title: ROYAL BLEND
products.body_html:
L'élégance royale dévoilée : présentation de Royal Blend  Fabriqué par French Avenue et perfectionné par Fragrance World, Royal Blend n'est pas seulement un parfum, c'est un extrait de parfum de 100 ml qui incarne la sophistication et le luxe. Cette création opulente est méticuleusement conçue pour captiver les sens, évoquant une aura d'élégance royale qui la distingue des autres.

Une symphonie de notes :

  • Notes de tête : Cognac, Cannelle, Prune
  • Notes de cœur : Iris, Myrrhe
  • Notes de fond : Fèves Tonka, Vanille, Bois de Santal

Dévoiler l'opulence : Au premier plan, Royal Blend éblouit avec une fusion somptueuse de cognac, de cannelle et de prune. Ce triumvirat de parfums attire l'attention, mélangeant des épices riches à une douceur fruitée et une profondeur chaleureuse et enveloppante grâce au cognac.

Sophistication sincère : Au cœur du parfum, l'iris et la myrrhe règnent en maîtres. La délicatesse florale de l'iris s'entremêle à la myrrhe résineuse et balsamique, créant un mélange enivrant qui respire la sophistication et le charme, captivant les sens à chaque bouffée.

Une finale luxueuse : Au fur et à mesure que le parfum s'installe, il révèle une base somptueuse où les fèves tonka, la vanille et le bois de santal occupent le devant de la scène. Ici, la douceur crémeuse de la vanille s'harmonise avec les tons chauds et réconfortants des fèves tonka, tandis que le bois de santal aromatique ajoute une sophistication terreuse qui persiste sur la peau.

Digne de la royauté : Royal Blend n'est pas seulement un parfum, c'est une expérience digne de la royauté. Que vous participiez à un grand événement ou que vous souhaitiez simplement rehausser votre quotidien, ce parfum exquis laisse une impression indélébile, témoignage de votre appréciation des bonnes choses de la vie.
